## Today

`PasteErrorUiState` carries only `title`, `body` and `rawRow`.
`PasteErrorViewModel.buildUiState` sets `rawRow` from
`failure.rawRow` and nothing else describing the expected form.
`PasteErrorScreen` renders `uiState.rawRow` as the row-as-pasted
text when non-null, with no counterpart showing an illustrated
expected form beside it — the screen's own comment states the
correction is only ever carried in the body's words, never as a
reconstructed row.

## Expected

`PasteErrorUiState` carries a field for the illustrated expected
form alongside `rawRow`. `PasteErrorViewModel.buildUiState`
populates it from the failure, and `PasteErrorScreen` renders it
beside the row as pasted whenever it is present.
